results.detail_markdown:
Jolene.pro: Spreadsheet Analysis with Source-Cell References

[Jolene.pro](https://jolene.pro/) is an AI spreadsheet analysis tool for Excel and CSV files. It works across multiple sheets and separate tables, helping people understand complete reports without manually tracing every formula, row, and reference.

Write what you need in plain English. Jolene.pro finds the relevant data, explains the calculation, creates a chart when useful, and shows the exact cells, rows, and sheets used for the result.

What Jolene.pro does

Jolene.pro is designed for spreadsheet work that goes beyond a single clean table. A workbook might contain sales on one sheet, returns on another, targets somewhere else, and formulas connecting all three. Jolene.pro works with that structure and keeps the supporting source beside each answer.

Key features include:

- Analysis across multiple Excel sheets and separate table areas
- Support for Excel and CSV files
- Plain-English questions about spreadsheet data
- Bar, line, area, pie, and heatmap charts
- Calculation explanations for each result
- References to the source cells, rows, and sheets used
- Saved analyses that can run again on updated reports
- Dashboard widgets for frequently monitored findings
- Read-only snapshots for sharing results
- Sheet controls for focusing on one sheet or a selected group of sheets

Built for recurring spreadsheet reports

Many spreadsheet tasks return every week or month with updated numbers. Jolene.pro lets users save an analysis and run it again when the next file arrives.

For example, a finance team can save its budget-versus-actual analysis and reuse it with the following month’s workbook. An operations team can repeat an overdue-actions report without rebuilding the questions. If the workbook structure changes, Jolene.pro warns the user instead of quietly pretending everything is fine.

Common use cases

Jolene.pro can help with:

- Budget versus actual analysis
- Monthly management reporting
- Sales pipeline and stage analysis
- Revenue, returns, and collections comparisons
- Invoice and billing reconciliation
- Inventory and order analysis
- Overdue actions grouped by owner
- Performance comparisons across teams or periods
- Corporate development and due-diligence work
- Repeated Excel and CSV reporting

Who is Jolene.pro for?

Jolene.pro is built for finance teams, operations teams, FP&A and MIS analysts, consultants, corporate development teams, business analysts, founders, and managers who regularly work with spreadsheet reports.

It is especially useful when the answer depends on several sheets or tables and someone will eventually ask, “Where did that number come from?”

What makes Jolene.pro different?

General file-analysis tools can summarize a spreadsheet. Jolene.pro is built specifically around workbook structure, source-cell references, calculation details, and repeatable analysis.

The result is not separated from its evidence. Users can inspect the cells behind a number before sharing it with a colleague, client, or manager.

Jolene.pro includes a free tier with 2,000 credits at signup. Failed processing or analysis requests do not deduct credits.

Learn more at [Jolene.pro](https://jolene.pro/).

You should not need a second spreadsheet to explain the first one.
